title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners) (m/w/d), Munich
description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Munich or Frankfurt).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Home office and workation possibility
  • Flexible working hours
  • Subsidised EGYM Wellpass
  • Apple hardware (laptop & iPhone)


These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.
  2. Content & Role Fit Interview - Go deeper into the role with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.
  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth. • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes. • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish. • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning. • Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams. • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature. • Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges. • Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making. • Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. title: QuickMail: Technical Customer Support
description: Headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland URL: https://quickmail.com The role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What work looks like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable Every day • ⁠Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. • ⁠Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. • ⁠Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast. and set them up for success. • ⁠Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. • ⁠Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI • ⁠Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. • ⁠Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid • ⁠Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. • ⁠Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week • ⁠Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. • ⁠Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Requirements Who you are • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like loom. • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A plus if you have • Have experience with customer facing, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup, . We can teach this, but a head start helps. • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How we work together You’ll work directly with me, the founder, and with our lead developer. Working with me can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: • My replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something I wrote lands badly or isn’t clear, ask me. • My direction can change. I may say one thing, then something different a few days later as I learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. • I prefer information to be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if I ask. • I can stay frustrated about a problem until it’s solved. That's something I'm aware of and working on. You’ll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. • We often think fast and interrupt each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn’t for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn’t take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion we need your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. Benefits • Contract type (full-time or part-time) • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099). • Start date: negotiable To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/quickmail-technical-customer-support

Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. title: GTM Operations
description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

This is a commercially focused GTM Operations role supporting Heidi’s UK and European markets. You’ll report to the Head of GTM Operations and work closely with leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Finance, as well as our central Analytics and GTM Engineering teams.

Your job is to turn commercial direction into an operating model the region can actually use. When leaders agree how we should forecast, segment accounts, organise territories or manage the customer lifecycle, you’ll build the models, processes, reporting and tooling that make it work day to day.

Doing that well means working beyond the CRM. You’ll use HubSpot, Databricks and Omni to bring together commercial and product data, pressure-test assumptions and turn what you find into better decisions and processes.

This role suits someone who enjoys both sides of GTM Operations: working through commercial problems with leaders, then doing the hands-on work to make the solution stick.

 

What you’ll do

  • Turn commercial plans into working operations. Partner with the Head of GTM Operations and regional leaders to operationalise decisions on segmentation, territories, coverage, capacity, quotas and commissions. Build the models, processes and operating cadences that allow teams to execute them consistently.

  • Connect the full customer lifecycle. Build and improve the processes between Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, from lead management and pipeline creation through onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion. Make ownership and handoffs clear, and ensure each team has the information it needs from the others.

  • Strengthen commercial execution. Improve how we inspect pipeline, forecast revenue and understand customer health, retention and growth. Help embed methodologies such as MEDDIC into the way managers and teams run deals—not just the fields they complete in HubSpot—and drive adoption of the changes you introduce.

  • Use data to support commercial decisions. Query existing datasets in Databricks, build reporting in Omni and connect CRM, product and commercial data to understand performance. Build the recurring reporting the region needs, investigate issues in more depth when required and explain what changed, why it matters and what action it suggests.

  • Keep the GTM engine running. Maintain HubSpot and the regional GTM stack, including pipelines, routing, workflows, reporting and data quality. Resolve issues quickly and partner with central teams when something needs a global fix.

 

What you'll need

  • Hands-on GTM Operations experience. You’ve worked in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations or Sales Operations and have practical experience with core processes such as forecasting, territory and quota planning, lifecycle management and CRM workflows. We care more about the ownership and judgement you’ve developed than a fixed number of years.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can reason across Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, understand the drivers of acquisition, conversion, adoption, retention and expansion, and distinguish an interesting data point from something the business should act on.

  • Confident with data. You can write SQL, navigate a warehouse such as Databricks and work with a BI tool such as Omni. You’re comfortable interrogating existing datasets, validating the output and turning the result into a clear recommendation. Experience building core warehouse models is not required.

  • A strong, credible operator. You can take an agreed commercial approach and turn it into a workable model, process or system change. You communicate clearly, challenge assumptions with evidence, bring the right people with you and follow through until the change is adopted.

  • A practical, tool-fluent systems thinker. You understand how process, data, tooling and team behaviour interact. You’re confident in HubSpot and have worked with tools such as Clay, Gong, outbound platforms, enrichment providers and CPQ/CLM systems, or can get productive in them quickly.

 

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer health and dental cover, a £700 annual learning and development budget, a £100/month health and wellness allowance, a £500 home office budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, four weeks of work from anywhere per year, and serious equity.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.

That's your world.
As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:
